thread:
Priya (oncall): FYI - we're seeing a clear uptick in 5xx from the hosted inference gateway since the canary that went out ~10:11 UTC. Customers reporting timeouts and errors via support tickets.

Maya (support): Got 3 tickets already: #INC-4582, #INC-4583, #INC-4584. All show 502/503 when calling /v1/generate. One customer sent curl showing 502 body.

support-bot: New ticket attached -> INC-4582 (high) - affected region: us-east-1 - frequency: 1.2% requests 5xx last 5m.

Priya (oncall): Numbers from Grafana: 5xx rate for gateway increased from 0.2% -> 4.8% in last 8m. Lat p95 for generate jumped from 180ms -> 1.6s. Canary traffic is at 10%.

ops-bot: Deploy bot: canary rollout 2026-03-15T10:10:54Z started by Alex, change: runtime flag toggle "enable_adaptive_kv_eviction=true" on model-prod runtime pool. Canary traffic: 10%.

Sam (runtime): That flag is new-ish. It evicts cached KV entries more aggressively. Could be causing cache thrash for long-context models. If eviction increases cache misses, token generation could recompile or stall and overload workers -> 5xx.

Jordan (sre): I can confirm worker OOMs spiked on hostpool-infer-13/14 around 10:12. Getting restart loops. Kernel logs show repeated eviction/gc churn.

Alex (deploy): Wait - the rollout config should have had the flag off for canary. Our canary image picked a config variant by mistake. I'm checking the feature-flag service now.

Sam (runtime): Can you dump the runtime config for the canary replicas? Cmd: ```kubectl -n inference get configmap runtime-config-canary -o yaml``` Look for "enable_adaptive_kv_eviction" and "kv_eviction_threshold".

Alex (deploy): Ran it: ```enable_adaptive_kv_eviction: "true"
kv_eviction_threshold: "0.2"``` That explains it - threshold is too low. Canary should have used "false".

Maya (support): Customers want ETA. Any mitigation steps? They are seeing retries and billing concerns.

Priya (oncall): Immediate mitigation: 1) Pause canary traffic, 2) Disable flag via feature-flag service, 3) Roll canary back if needed. Jordan, can you throttle routing to canary from gateway?

Jordan (sre): Yes. Running: ```/scripts/set-route-weight.sh gateway-canary 0``` -> executed. Canary weight now 0%. Gateway metrics show 5xx dropping but still elevated due to restarts.

Sam (runtime): Also push an emergency flag flip: ```ffctl set enable_adaptive_kv_eviction false --env=prod --target=runtime-pool-canary``` Alex, can you do that?

Alex (deploy): Done. API response OK. Propagating to instances.

ops-bot: Feature flag change detected by rollout-system: enable_adaptive_kv_eviction=false at 10:23:11 UTC. Filters updating.

Jordan (sre): Pods are stabilizing. Restart rate for infer pods dropped from 4/min -> 0.6/min. 5xx currently down to 0.9% and trending down.

Sam (runtime): Root cause summary: accidental canary variant picked up adaptive eviction flag + aggressive threshold caused KV cache thrash and worker restarts leading to gateway 5xx.

Maya (support): I posted an update to the affected ticket queue and messaged the top customers with incident note. Customers asked about refunds for failed requests — Sales asked to route billing questions to finance.

Priya (oncall): Next steps: 1) Leave canary weight 0 until we validate a corrected config image, 2) Run loadtest against corrected config in staging for longer tails, 3) Postmortem + config gating. Alex, coordinate image and config fix. Jordan, prepare rollback playbook + customer comms template.

Alex (deploy): Working on rebuild now. Found root cause: templating bug in deploy pipeline that defaulted the flag to env-level default when canary override missing. Patching pipeline to require explicit flag for canaries and add validation. Tests will run in staging.

Sam (runtime): Also add runtime healthcheck to detect KV eviction thrash: alert if eviction rate > X and worker restarts > Y in 5m. Can hook to Optimize recommendations later.

Jordan (sre): I'll create a short runbook: command snippets to mute canary, flip flag, and escalate. Putting draft in #incidents-runbooks.

Maya (support): I updated customers: initial apology, mitigations performed, monitoring in place, ETA for full resolution ~40m pending fix validation.

Priya (oncall): Good. For transparency: create incident ticket and assign Sev2. I'll lead the postmortem. Everyone: paste any logs/snippets you used here for the postmortem.

Sam (runtime): Paste of the key log snippet showing eviction churn: ```[10:12:34] kv_cache: evicting 512 entries, active_cache_items=1200 -> 700
[10:12:35] worker[13]: failed to allocate kv buffer: OOM
[10:12:35] runtime: restarting worker pid=4271
[10:12:36] kv_cache: rehydrate miss=1.2k
```

Alex (deploy): Pipeline patch PR: https://git.internal/redwood/deploy/pull/892 - adds explicit canary flag validation and a preflight check.

Jordan (sre): I'll follow up with a post-incident changelog: require canary config diff sign-off by runtime owner before >0% traffic.

Priya (oncall): Thanks team. I'll keep this thread open until postmortem is published. If anything regresses, ping @Priya directly. :thumbsup: 

support-bot: Incident created -> INC-4585 (sev2) - assigned to Priya. Link: https://support.redwood/incidents/INC-4585

Alex (deploy): Switching to monitoring mode. Will update once new canary passes staging load test.

Maya (support): Closing customer-facing notes as 'Mitigated' for now. Will reopen if errors recur.

Priya (oncall): End of thread for now. Postmortem doc placeholder: /docs/postmortems/1971234567-canary-kv-eviction.json
